clips.text: Section one, the Pact. The Athar Open Agentic Pact is an open commitment between institutions, partners and platforms to learn, build and deploy agentic AI for public benefit. It is a community proposal from ODA and AI Rev, designed as a community, not a product. Signatories agree on shared standards, an open plugin approach and measurable real-world outcomes.

clips.text: Section three, six pillars. Plugins are the connective tissue: one shared plugin standard, so every integration works everywhere. Reusable skills are built once and shared across the community. Universal API licences are managed by Athar, giving members access without duplicated procurement.

clips.text: Section four, Pledge and Signing. Joining the Pact is a simple public commitment. A signatory chooses its roles, sign, govern, build or learn, and pledges to contribute to at least one of the four participant outcomes. Signing brings access to the learning pathway, the builder journey, and the plugin standard, together with a commitment to report outcomes through the shared impact tiers.

clips.text: Section six, governance and roadmap. An open steering council sets the shared plugin standard and approves the roadmap. Decisions, releases, and outcome reports are published, so every member can see how priorities are set and how the platform evolves over time.

clips.text: Section seven, Impact and Funding. Three impact tiers, one delivery model, access, ownership, legacy. A funder can enter at any tier and climb. Every agreement includes named cohorts and activation targets, independent evaluator baselines, quarterly outcome reports, and open book costs with unspent funds returned. Universal API licenses, marketplace revenue share and sovereign pilot options fund the model so each partner can choose what fits.
